thread:
Priya: quick handoff from the overnight pager. embeddings-service in eu-west-1 was seeing a burst of 503s due to repeated worker evictions after an autoscale bounce. I mitigated and want to pass context + follow-ups. Incident timeline is below and I left runbook pointers.

IncidentBot: Paging — P1 embeddings-service 503 spike (eu-west-1). Alert fired 2460123310. Alert link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/embeddings-503-2460123310 :rotating_light:

Priya: short summary — root cause appears to be a combination of a mis-tuned eviction setting (+ aggressive node autoscaler cooldown) and a new quantized model variant using more ephemeral RAM, causing OOM/evict thrash. Symptoms: ~5–15% 503 rate for ~18 minutes, steady requests queued, heavy retries caused more pressure. I rolled back the quantized variant to the stable float32 pool and scaled replicas x2 which stabilized success rate.

Jason: thanks — any customer-facing incidents? do we have lists of affected keys/tenants?

Priya: quick customer note — no enterprise customer reported a hard outage; a few internal tests and some 429/503s for lower-tier traffic. We sent a brief note to SRE-scheduling channel and to CS triage. No paid-customer SLA breaches detected in the window.

Luca: runbook pointer? which steps did you follow so I can replicate?

Priya: followed runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/embeddings/503-eviction. Key steps I used: 1) move traffic off quantized variant, 2) scale up replicas, 3) disable aggressive preemption on the pool (set node taint), 4) watch tail of logs. Commands I ran:
```
# scale deployment
kubectl -n inference scale deployment embeddings-deploy --replicas=6
# rollback model tag
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/models/rollout -d '{"model":"emu-embed-v2-quant","target":"emu-embed-v2-float"}'
# check recent 503s
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embeddings --tail=200 | grep HTTP/1.1\" 503
```

Ruth: noted. Who's primary for the rest of the shift? we need someone to own monitoring and the follow-up ticket.

Priya: handing primary to Jason for remainder of shift — I’ll be available for questions for another hour. Jason will be primary, Ruth is secondary. @Jason you good to pick up the pager?

Jason: taking primary. I’ll keep an eye on error-rate dashboards and the autoscaler metrics. If 503 > 1% for more than 10m, escalate to infra-core and start mitigation playbook.

OpsBot: Action logged — handoff recorded: from Priya to Jason at 2460123456. Oncall roster updated.

Luca: quick note — we should file a ticket to revisit eviction thresholds and model memory profiling for quantized variants. This is a repeat pattern.

Priya: agreed. I created INF-7842 (investigate eviction thresholds + autoscaler cooldown). INF-7843 created for "model memory-profile: quantized variants". Links: https://tracker.redwood/INF-7842, https://tracker.redwood/INF-7843

Jason: assigning INF-7842 to Luca, INF-7843 to Priya. I also added a short remediation task: add a canary traffic rule for new model variants so we don't shift full traffic immediately.

Luca: ack. tentative owner for remediation work — me for autoscaler tuning, Priya for model memory analysis. ETA for triage: tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

Priya: scheduled a short retro for tomorrow 11:00 UTC — invites sent to eng-runtime, eng-sre, and product-ml. Agenda: 1) revisit autoscaler defaults, 2) model rollout guardrails (canary + memory smoke tests), 3) alert sensitivity tuning.

Jason: follow-ups for me during shift: 1) confirm 503s stay <0.5% for next 3 hours, 2) coordinate with cs if customers ask, 3) update the incident log with exact times and commands run. I will also attach logs to INF-7842.

Priya: added quick mitigation notes to incident log: "rolled back quantized variant at 2460123365; scaled to 6 replicas at 2460123380; preemption disabled on pool at 2460123395; error rate normalized by 2460123470."

Ruth: thanks for the handoff. small coverage note — our scheduled EU deploy window is tonight at 02:00 local; recommend canceling until INF-7842 is triaged.

Jason: agreed — paused the EU deploy window in the calendar and notified deploy-cancels channel.

Luca: for the retro, I’ll pull resource metrics (RSS, RSS delta on spawn) and GC logs for the quantized binary. Priya — can you paste a sample of the OOM lines you saw?

Priya: pasted a short snippet below for the ticket:
```
2026-03-14T23:12:01Z embeddings-pod-02 kubelet: eviction signal: memory.available < 100Mi
2026-03-14T23:12:07Z embeddings-pod-02 embeddings: model load failed: OOM when allocating 256MB
2026-03-14T23:12:09Z embeddings-pod-02 kube-proxy: container had non-zero exit (OOMKilled)
2026-03-14T23:12:30Z embeddings-proxy 503 "upstream error"
```

Jason: perfect, attaching to INF-7843. Anything else before I take over monitoring?

Priya: nope — all context is in the incident log and tickets. Thanks team. I’ll check in tomorrow for triage. :slightly_smiling_face:

IncidentBot: Incident closed (P1 -> mitigated). Final note: monitoring alerts suppressed for 30m to avoid noise.

Jason: closing thread for handoff notes. Will reopen if alerts recur. :eyes:
